Company Overview
Join our innovative team at RECAP, a startup revolutionizing the real estate investment landscape. We are looking for a talented Full Stack Developer to be one of the first members of our team, with significant influence over our technology direction.

Job Description
As a Full Stack Developer at RECAP, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining the full stack of our software applications. Your role will involve working on both the front-end and back-end components, ensuring seamless integration and a user-friendly experience.

Responsibilities

Develop and maintain software applications across the full stack.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement new features.

Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.

Troubleshoot and debug applications.

Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices.

Stay up-to-date with emerging trends and technologies in software development.

Requirements

Proven experience as a Full Stack Developer or similar role.

Proficiency in front-end frameworks, particularly Vue.js.

Experience with back-end development using PHP and Laravel.

Strong knowledge of databases, particularly MySQL.

Understanding of the software development lifecycle and best practices.

Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.

Qualifications

1-5 years of experience in full stack development.

Experience with front-end build tools and task runners.

Knowledge of modern front-end development workflows and tools.

Experience with cloud services (e.g., AWS, Azure).

Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines.

Why Join Us

Be part of a small, fast-paced team working closely with the founders.

Significant influence over technology direction and company growth.

Opportunities for professional growth and development.

Competitive salary and potential for equity participation.

How to Apply
If you are passionate about software development and eager to take on new challenges, we invite you to join us in revolutionizing the real estate investment industry. Please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your qualifications and why you are a good fit for the role at RECAP.
